name: Natalie Koval
source: A Ukrainian woman who lost her son in the car crash due to a drunk driving incident involving the main character, John. At first, in her grief, she wanted nothing more than to get revenge against John, but ends up partially forgiving him noticing that he feels great remorse for what he did and that he has suffered quite a bit since then.
